name: Balance pass: the Level law timed on the MID four on Dangerous (seat multiple 1.266, was 1.492)
why: R13 times the XP a Level costs on the MID four on Deadly with no death (1.492 times the pace contract). The sitting ruled Deadly a tier you watch or gamble on and Dangerous the idle tier (S-6), so the four that is left alone hunts Dangerous. Its multiple is 1.266 (the median of 28 checkpoints from Level 30 to 400, range 0.94 to 1.98, MEASURED on run 44920906999, 2 seeds of 2 hours). On 1.492 that four reaches Level 400 on day 472. On 1.266 it reaches it on day 400, and a four that farms Deadly with no death is there on day 326. Layer: coefficient, the one number of the Level law. Applies on top of R13

measuredOn.seat: the MID four (hammer, bow, mage, healer) on Dangerous, pull 5
